reads.question: How are metrics endpoint authentication filters enforced, how is the webhook server identity established, and what TLS lifecycle governs serving surfaces?
reads.expected_signal: controller-runtime metrics options with authentication filter, webhook server TLS configuration, health probe registration
reads.scope_reason: Range covers metrics options (485-500), webhook server setup (501-504), controller registration (551-587), and health probes (612-618); narrower reads would miss the initialization sequence connecting TLS profile to both serving surfaces

reads.expected_signal: oauth2-proxy container args with OIDC provider, TLS cert/key paths, OAuth client secret references, K8s token validation flag

reads.question: Which literal namespace names constrain the auth service controller watches, and what events do they route?

reads.question: How are outbound Kubernetes API clients configured, what credentials and TLS settings are used?

reads.question: What build flags, GOEXPERIMENT settings, and base image establish or limit FIPS compliance?
reads.expected_signal: CGO_ENABLED, GOEXPERIMENT=strictfipsruntime, -tags strictfipsruntime, UBI base image

reads.question: How does the gateway controller select between OIDC, external provider, and K8s token validation authentication modes?
reads.expected_signal: GatewayConfig spec field checks, conditional OIDC configuration, provider CA and token validation settings
reads.scope_reason: Range covers getTemplateData function which assembles all authentication-relevant template variables from GatewayConfig spec; narrower reads would miss the conditional OIDC, provider CA, and token validation logic
